title: Texas court overturns $45,000 fee order against woman in home payment dispute
summary_full: A Texas appeals court has overturned a $45,000 legal fee order against Gloria Salinas, who says she paid more than $130,000 for a house bought under a $47,500 agreement. The court found that questions over payment records, additional charges and the seller's accounting required further examination. It sent the dispute back to the lower court.
